description: A vertical snapshot with deckled edges featuring a smiling young mother standing behind a dark wooden picket fence while holding her toddler son, Jim. Behind them is a residential bungalow or cottage with horizontal siding, a screen door, and house number 5118 visible above a small porch light fixture. A ladder leans against the exterior wall on the left.
